title: Working through a situation step by step
description: The event, the thought and the feeling are written in separate, clear fields.

blocks.text: Free text is sometimes hard to start, and a long questionnaire gets in the way of finishing an entry.

quote.text: I really find CBT helpful. I used to do a 7-column worksheets but wanted that worksheet in app form. And this is basically it. Simple, easy interface, and just the grounding I usually need.

blocks.text: Offer a short structure with the option to skip a field and come back later. Keep the person’s own wording and show the whole episode together.
This is a format for a personal entry, not an automatic conclusion or a promise of a result from therapy.
